name: Customer logo wall
definition: Row or grid of customer logos in one muted colour under a short line that says who they are.
bestUse: Early in a page, when recognisable customers are the fastest proof.

demo.how: Logos are set in one neutral tone and equal visual weight so no single brand dominates, under a line that names the kind of customer. Play shows the line, then fades in the two rows. Real walls use permission-cleared logos; these are placeholders, never real brand marks.
